item.title: Manual: Spaces
item.description:
📝 Word space Standard space, word space, space per se, is the symbol typed using the widest key on the keyboard. In metal type, the size of standard space varied depending on the typographic tradition, in most cases the space was rather wide. Jost Hochuli Detail in Typography (2008) Blank space between words should be s.
